blocks.p: A profile keeps a mod list with its load order. The *Mod profiles* window holds your profiles: the list at the left gives each profile with how many mods it holds, and the pane at the right describes the profile picked.

Under *Loading it* the pane lists what loading the profile would change: the mods it turns off, and any mod it names that is not installed. Such a mod stays off. Under *Load order* the pane gives the order the profile keeps, numbered from the top.
*Load* loads the profile picked. *New...* saves the list in use as a new profile, and *Update...* saves it into the profile picked. Profiles are kept in Zomboid/Lua/ZeD_modprofiles.txt.

marks.text: Loading a profile says what it turns off.
A mod it lists that you do not have is named, and stays off.
Each profile keeps its own load order.

sticky.text: A profile keeps a mod list and its load order.

blocks.p: The *Load order* window lists the mods that are on, numbered in the order the game loads them: the top loads first. To move a mod, pick it and click *Move Up* or *Move Down*. A mod moves one place at a time.
The pane at the right of the window names what the picked mod needs; a mod it needs must load first. Each row carries a square mark for its place in the order (Table 54-1).

table.label: Table 54-1
table.title: The marks in the load order
head: Mark
Meaning
rows: A mod it needs loads later, or is not in the list.
One of its own wishes to load before or after a mod is not kept.

blocks.p: While a row is red, *Done* waits. *Auto* sets the order by the mods' own rules: each mod after the mods it needs.
On a controller, *Y* moves the picked mod up and *X* moves it down.
*Done* keeps the order. When the order is saved, every mod a mod needs is put in front of it, so the game never loads a mod before what it needs.

marks.text: Crafting Pack loads before the Crafting Core it needs.
Done waits until the order is fixed. Auto sets it.

sticky.text: A red row loads before what it needs.
